predictions.title: MCP host runtimes ship sandboxed stdio tool execution as the default by Q2 2027

recent_bridges.bridge_text: The Vertex RCE - untrusted input deserialized in a privileged context runs arbitrary code and lifts a cloud-scoped OAuth token - reinforces the broad case for isolating tool and artifact execution by default. But it concerns model-artifact deserialization in a managed-serving path, not MCP stdio tool execution, so the tie to the sandboxed-stdio landing is thematic and weak.

OWASP's Agentic AI Security v2.01 ties real exploits straight to the tool-execution surface - the MCP RCE CVE-2025-6514 at CVSS 9.6, a Codex CLI sandbox bypass, Cursor environment poisoning - with coding agents now the center of risk. That incident-driven pressure is the strongest case yet for the Q2 2027 prediction's sandboxed-stdio default.

Two same-day launches push sandboxed agent execution to the foreground: OpenAI Ona runs coding agents inside persistent cloud sandboxes, and Kimi Work executes Python locally while leaving files untouched until approved. Both treat tool execution as something to isolate and gate by default, hardening the same instinct, though neither names MCP host runtimes or stdio transport.

The live LiteLLM exploitation sharpens the premise that unauthenticated remote MCP surfaces are the core failure. Two unauthenticated test endpoints accept a full server config and spawn it on the proxy host, yielding remote code execution with no login or API key. CISA's KEV listing and the authenticate-every-caller remediation turn the optional-auth gap into an actively-exploited one.

The NSA's design-considerations document names the inverted client-server pattern, unverified task propagation and arbitrary-code-execution as core risks and ranks tool-poisoning highest because malicious server metadata enters the agent's context with instruction-level authority before review - exactly the in-host execution boundary the thesis says must move into an isolated launcher. VIPER-MCP's 67 CVEs confirm a per-field patch cannot be the defense.
